offerBoundary.authentication: Dedicated bearer contract token distinct from checkout and lifecycle-receipt credentials; secret bytes are never recorded.
requiredBindings: bounded attributable-cost quote and receipt schema
offerBoundary.decision: TTI appends an independent TTIVaultProviderOfferAdmissionDecision that may only qualify the offer for testing. After seven exact customer-observed tests cover all ten requirements, a separate non-synthetic TTIVaultProviderOperationalAdmissionDecision may satisfy the later activation's providerOffering evidence slot.

provider: Fixed provider catalog offering and price derivation
Raw Stripe webhook signature verification and event deduplication
Privacy-preserving provider checkout and lifecycle receipts
Provider fee and Stripe processing-cost receipts
customer: Discord identity and private checkout invitation
Opaque order reference and local Discord-account binding
Product terms, entitlement decisions, Discord role fulfillment, content fulfillment, customer support, and books
Independent receipt admission, revenue recognition, cost attribution, retention, and profit measurement

requiredCapabilities.must: Offer exactly the fixed product, offering, plan, subscription mode, USD 500-cent P1M price, quantity one, beneficiary, and legal merchant named above.
requiredCapabilities.evidence: Provider-authored catalog receipt bound to the potential provider contract.

requiredCapabilities.must: Derive all Stripe price and recurrence fields from the admitted provider catalog; refuse caller price, currency, interval, mode, quantity, and beneficiary overrides.
requiredCapabilities.evidence: Mutation and negative acceptance tests plus provider service offer digest.

requiredCapabilities.must: Create subscription-mode Checkout idempotently from the customer solicitation while keeping Discord identity outside the provider boundary.
requiredCapabilities.evidence: Test-mode Checkout receipt showing opaque order/request correlation and no Discord identifier or buyer payment data.

requiredCapabilities.must: Propagate request_digest, offering_id, and customer_settlement correlation to the created Subscription and recurring Invoices, not only the Checkout Session.
requiredCapabilities.evidence: Test-mode provider receipts for Checkout, Subscription, and first and second Invoice sharing the admitted correlation.

requiredCapabilities.must: Verify raw Stripe signatures, enforce replay tolerance and body bounds, deduplicate, and keep raw bodies and buyer personal/payment data inside the provider boundary.
requiredCapabilities.evidence: Provider webhook-law tests and privacy-preserving event receipt.

requiredCapabilities.must: Emit authenticated full provider receipts for checkout.session.completed, checkout.session.expired, invoice.paid, invoice.payment_failed, customer.subscription.updated, customer.subscription.deleted, charge.refunded, and dispute/chargeback lifecycle events.
requiredCapabilities.evidence: Provider-authored event capability manifest and test receipts delivered across the customer contract.

requiredCapabilities.must: Treat every provider receipt as evidence offered to TTI and never directly write TTI orders, entitlements, Discord roles, fulfillment records, revenue, profit, or books.
requiredCapabilities.evidence: Contract law and tests proving zero customer-settlement mutations.

requiredCapabilities.must: Deliver full privacy-preserving receipts to TTI through an authenticated, idempotent inter-enterprise boundary and support customer acknowledgment/retry.
requiredCapabilities.evidence: Receipt-delivery contract, authentication evidence, duplicate delivery test, and TTI acknowledgment receipt.

requiredCapabilities.must: Separate test and live catalogs/credentials; a test offering or synthetic receipt can never activate live Checkout, entitlement, revenue, or profit.

Quote and receipt all provider charges, Stripe processing fees, refunds, disputes, chargebacks, taxes collected, and payout adjustments at the event or settlement boundary TTI needs for honest unit economics.
requiredCapabilities.evidence: Provider fee schedule and per-period cost/payout receipt schema.

eventConsequences.providerMeaning: Initial Checkout completed with declared payment state
eventConsequences.ttiConsequence: Independent initial entitlement admission only when correlation, offering, mode, and paid state pass
Close or re-offer the pending checkout binding; never infer payment, entitlement, or revenue
Dunning/grace review; never immediate invented profit or refund

eventConsequences.providerMeaning: Correlated charge was partially or fully refunded
eventConsequences.ttiConsequence: Independent entitlement/economics review based on amount and paid-through law
Independent risk, reserve, access, and economics review

providerCostCeilingHypothesis.basis: per successfully settled subscriber-month including payment processing and provider service, before refunds/disputes/tax

unknowns: Vault fulfillment labor and inference cost
economics.rule: The ceiling is a TTI procurement hypothesis, not a provider offer or accepted cost. Profit remains unknown until externally settled revenue and all attributable costs are receipted.

activationSequence: Provider returns a content-addressed ActivityStreams service offer and cost quote through the dedicated authenticated offer boundary
TTI witnesses the ingress and appends a qualified-for-test or refused customer-side offer decision
TTI runs all test-mode acceptance and negative tests
TTI appends a separate operational admission only when seven self-addressed customer-observed test receipts pass all ten requirements
Provider and TTI witness test receipts and compatibility reading through their own WitnessJournal providers
Leader and qualified reviewers admit complete commercial, tax, privacy, refund, cancellation, dispute, payout, and fulfillment terms
Public HTTPS and both authenticated service borders are proven
Separate live activation evidence binds exact catalog, contracts, terms, territory, and role
One explicitly authorized low-volume pilot may begin; no bulk or retroactive charging
neverEvidence: This solicitation, source inspection, code, a test offer, a Checkout Session, a Discord role, or a provider estimate is not provider acceptance, payment, revenue, entitlement, fulfillment, or profit.
